text:
The data look like late 2018: the fed funds rate is about 2.20% (the Sept/Oct 2018 level), the 10-year yield is 3.03%, and the 2-year is 2.81%. Unemployment is 3.7%, which matches Sept–Nov 2018.

The 3m equity return of -4.6% with a 12m drawdown of -5.7% and a 1m return of +1.9% suggests November 2018. October 2018 would have shown a larger 1m loss, and the 10-year yield was about 3.0% at the end of November. Fed funds averaged 2.20% in November (2.19% in October), and the VIX at 18.79 fits late November (about 18.1 on Nov 30). Headline CPI at 2.5% fits the November 2018 reading for October.

The one-month gains in EM equity (+4.9%) and Treasuries (+1.3%) also fit November better than October.
